traits.name: Aggressive
traits.text:
As a bonus action, the orc can
move up to its speed toward a hostile creature it
can see.

traits.name: Minion: Savage Horde
traits.text:
After moving at least 20
feet in a straight line toward a creature, the next
attack the orc makes against that creature scores
a critical hit on a roll of 18–20.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
The White Tusk Bloodrager makes
three falchion attacks.

actions.name: Falchion
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5
ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.
